column1: # Generated physical descriptions in Legends biographies and art-image pickers.
# Night-troll/angel behaviors and angel creators also come from generators/creatures.lua.
# Vocabulary: existing creature profiles, materials, colors and anatomy.
# description rows (h/v) are noun phrases; clause/behavior rows are prose.
# No world-specific names and no replacement race/material dictionary.
# Physical overview and appendages. The whole sentence is translated before
# link-aware layout, including adjectives containing native commas.
# {q} uses the existing data/runtime/rulesets/zh-Hans/color.toml vocabulary, not generic {s} word senses.
# Form and material clauses compose recursively, in native order.
# Native 53.16 biography builder (Linux 0xa12140): deity form flags append
# skeletal, rotting and ghostly independently, BEFORE optional female/male
# and the caste name. All three can therefore nest; do not enumerate species
# or replace their established translations. Ordinary ghosts use ghostly too.
# creature-status also exports these SAME prefixes to the species/caste parser
# used by named/unnamed event actors. Native actor formatter 0xa136b0 emits
# zombie before the caste (0xa13dde/0xa13fb3/0xa13fc7), not as a personal name.
# Keep the existing zombie = 僵尸 and all established description wording.
# Counts and classifiers belong to complete appendage phrases, not species.
